{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/bf6e7dbc9ef89c526c547f8d7360509b562aa2f4.png

Hello everyone!
I’ve made a number of updates since the last post, so here’s a summary of what’s new!

[hr][/hr]
Lv30 and Lv29 Unlocked!

 At Lv30, a new skill is added to the tech tree: "Faster Response Speed for Part-Timers".
 At Lv29, you can now unlock the Jam Maker and Storage Rack (SS).
You can also hire a sixth part-time worker.


New Customers

 Boy 4 (Lv18)
 Meerkat (Lv23)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/94ee5ff70382353ffcb8d0e03917764f0a9c7a56.png"]


New Skills

 Foraging Skill: Mushrooms (Lv28)
 A new skill has been added to foraging: "Increased Harvest Amount".
 New display skills have been added:
　・Vegetable Basket Upgrade Lv3, Lv4
　・Fruit Barrel Upgrade Lv3, Lv4


New Furniture

 Painting "Herbs" (Lv26)
 Delivery Bag (Lv28)
 Wind Turbine (Lv27)
 Wind Turbine II (Lv28)
 Solar Panel (Lv29)
 Storage Rack (SS) (Lv29)
 Jam Maker (Lv29)
 Painting "Green Breath" (Lv29)
 Wild Strawberry Vine Decoration
 Blueberry Vine Decoration
 Glass of Berries
 Nutcracker
 Mushroom Lamp
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/52ab0ddaa33b0bd8f0b48d2ec6696af15d4a48a0.png


New Products

 Granola
 Toilet Paper
 Eggplant
 Watermelon
 Donuts
 Bell Pepper
 Dragon Fruit
 Packaged Rice
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/9702c72905788db661d3b66c9770c7f68ee13cb0.png


Other Updates

 Manufactured items are no longer included in trend candidates.
 Grass no longer grows in invisible spots like behind trees.
 Land expansion has been added.
 A new Bag Skill has been added.
 "Safety Pin" was previously categorized as stationery?it has now been correctly reclassified as a daily necessity.
 If you move a production machine or put it in a box during manufacturing, its progress will now be reset.

[hr][/hr]
That’s it for this week’s update!

I want to thank everyone who reported bugs, streamed the game, and posted amazing screenshots on social media!

Also, a huge thank you to everyone who left a Steam review.
Reading your warm feedback really gives me the motivation to keep developing!

Thanks to your support, we’ve now surpassed 100 reviews?yay!
I’d be thrilled if we can continue to grow that number.

If you haven’t written a review yet, I’d be absolutely delighted if you did!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/dd1bd82e8fa78d041acb3382659ba4d7be5791c3.png"]

I’ll continue working on new updates going forward?stay tuned and enjoy!

Also, the “Storage Rack (Standard)” is now sold by the traveling merchant robot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/8fcf903817ad042c4c93e2a7a76b0d5ad40b0217.png

Two New Night Tracks Added

 The game now has a total of 7 music tracks. I plan to add more in the future!


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where items stacked near the garbage dump would be eaten by Yumyum if the top item’s image overlapped with the dump area.
 Fixed a rare bug where cardboard could not be placed after previously being collected at the dump.
 Fixed an issue where the description box would be hidden when selecting the bottom-most skill in the skill tree screen.
 Adjusted cardboard behavior when trying to place it in an invalid area so it no longer jumps far away.
 Fixed a bug where cardboard couldn’t be placed in a spot after a cat took an empty box from there.
 Fixed a bug where empty cardboard boxes of different sizes could be stored together in storage.
 Fixed abnormal behavior when trying to move to unreachable locations.
 Fixed a bug where some special bag effects didn’t apply correctly.
 Fixed a bug where cardboard could be endlessly taken from storage without a limit.
 Fixed strange behavior when animals left and returned to the register after placing acorns.


Other Updates

 Previously, cardboard around the garbage dump would be collected too, but now only items placed on the green tiles inside the dump will be collected.
 I added an effect to “Wood Pillar”: “2.5% chance of +1 satisfaction during daytime.”
 I added new store plot expansions.
 I added new bag skills.

[hr][/hr]

That’s all for this week’s update!

Thank you so much to everyone who reported bugs and those who streamed the game during this period!

Also, I’d like to express my heartfelt thanks to everyone who left a Steam review.
Your kind words really motivate me to keep developing the game!

If you haven’t written a review yet, I’d be very happy if you could leave even a short comment or first impression!!

Thank you.

Other Updates

 Areas where placement is not possible will now be highlighted in red.
 (If you attempt to place an item in a red area, it will be automatically placed in a valid location.)

 Items trending in the shop now appear in green.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the game would stutter when cats were present.

 Fixed a bug where carrying a cardboard box while completing a delivery would cause it to disappear.
 Fixed a bug where more than 10 cardboard boxes could be stacked.
 Fixed an issue where cardboard could not be discarded at the second garbage area.
 Fixed a bug where the "Garbage Disposal V" quest was not being counted.

 Fixed a bug where the Satisfaction Counter was not counting properly.
 Fixed an issue where outdoor decorations could be placed indoors.
 Fixed a bug where selecting a bag using a shortcut key at checkout would cause items to remain at the register.
 Fixed an issue where fallen items could no longer be displayed.
 Fixed a bug where the trend display would malfunction when no trend was active.

I want to express my sincere gratitude to everyone who reported bugs and those who streamed videos of the game.

Please look forward to it!

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/e00aef114a2681aa8d6bcd72dd1d499f555e1395.png

Hello everyone!
Here is a summary of the updates I made this week.

[hr][/hr]

Level 16 Unlocked

 The initial level cap was 15, but I have already unlocked Level 16 for the skilled players who reached the max level!

New Customers

 Deer
 Marmot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/dda9e59f0efdbd3d38cb5e0b4a52ab072aec0b05.png

New Furniture

 Vertical S Size Stand (Lv12)
   A vertical stand for small items. While it has only one slot, it can hold slightly more than usual.
 Net Stand (Lv13)
   A compact yet high-capacity stand that can display up to 20 items with display skill upgrades.
 Vending Machine (Lv15)
   Purchasing this unlocks the vending machine product license tree.
 Train shaped snacks shelf (Lv16)
   A shelf designed for displaying a large quantity of snacks.
 Neon Sign "FOOD"
 Sticker "OPEN"
 Sticker "Apple"
 Corrugated "OPEN" Sign
 Neon Sign "SHOP NOW"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/49d0cdc779583e5f8affb51503a1981a72ade165.gif

New Products

 Soda (Can)
 Green Tea (Can)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/794d0a29d24a485b95209aa909bf8f49dd9bc2b1.png

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where customers using the self-checkout would panic if the day ended, leaving items stuck in the register.
 Fixed a bug where fruit barrels and vegetable baskets would open a portal to another dimension and multiply infinitely.
 Fixed a bug where an overwhelming number of grid cells appeared on the screen due to passionate user enthusiasm.
 Fixed a bug where settings in the OPTION menu were not being saved.
 Fixed a bug where delivery rewards were incorrect.
 Fixed a bug where expanding the freezer box caused items to clip through the bottom.
 Fixed a bug where the purchase counter light would disappear after repeated achievements.
 Fixed a bug where a large tree growing above the store prevented the first shelf from being placed.
 Fixed incorrect values in "Your Records."
 Fixed a bug where certain NPCs could not be clicked during delivery.
 Fixed a bug where decorative items purchased from the traveling merchant robot displayed incorrect elements.
 Fixed a bug where some NPCs had unintended hitboxes.
 Fixed a bug where pressing ESC to close the menu made the game unresponsive.
 Fixed a bug where the dash cooldown bar did not display correctly at the start of the morning.
 Fixed a bug where the number of visitors in the daily results was incorrect.
 Fixed a bug where players could purchase furniture beyond the available stock.
 Fixed a bug where changing BGM volume in the OPTION menu did not immediately apply to the currently playing music.
 Fixed an issue with the placement range of the 3-tier S-size rack.

Other Updates

 Increased the expansion range of the freezer box display skill from 8→10→12.

[hr][/hr]

That concludes this week's main updates.


It has already been a week since the release.
I am truly grateful for all the players who have been enjoying the game since launch!

Thank you to everyone playing and supporting us!

A special thanks to those who have streamed the game and reported bugs!


Lastly, I would like to sincerely thank everyone who has written a STEAM review!
Reading your warm reviews gives us great motivation to continue development!

If you haven't written a review yet, I would be absolutely thrilled if you could!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/dd1bd82e8fa78d041acb3382659ba4d7be5791c3.png


I will continue to release various updates.
Please look forward to them!
